verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes a documented JMAP API (an API Documentation page, OAuth or Bearer-token auth, a methodCalls request model). The JMAP site lists a Rust library and a TypeScript library, but nothing establishes that these are official, Fastmail-maintained SDKs rather than ecosystem implementations, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: confirmation that the libraries are official Fastmail SDKs, SDK documentation (install, usage, versioning), language coverage beyond a passing list mention, independent or hands-on corroboration of building with them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
